action: Review the commission's findings to incorporate mental health metrics into human benefit assessments.

title: UN Warns COP30 Adaptation Pledge Falls Short for Poorer Nations
one_liner: The UN warns that existing COP30 adaptation pledges meet under a third of developing nations' needs.
why: Contextualizes the macroeconomic and governance constraints facing climate adaptation in the Global South.
action: Review UN adaptation gap estimates to support the rationale for international climate finance studies.

title: Urban and Municipal Development Fund by AfDB
one_liner: The African Development Bank Group highlights its Urban and Municipal Development Fund for urban projects.
why: Provides insights into financing mechanisms and municipal development projects relevant to the Global South.
action: Explore project templates and financing criteria used by the fund for urban planning.

title: Brazil’s Data-Driven Plan for Climate-Resilient Healthcare
one_liner: Brazil introduced a data-driven planning approach aimed at building climate-resilient healthcare systems.
why: Provides a Global South case study on utilizing spatial data and evidence for climate adaptation planning.
action: Examine the methodologies used in Brazil's data-driven framework for transferability.

title: Master of Science in Climate Change Validated in South Sudan
one_liner: UNDP, the University of Juba, and the Ministry of Environment validated a new Master of Science program.
why: Reflects capacity building and institutional strengthening for climate expertise within a fragile setting.
action: Observe curriculum structures used for capacity building in data-scarce and conflict-affected contexts.

title: Telangana Space Policy Planned for 2027 in Hyderabad
one_liner: Hyderabad has announced plans for a regional space policy slated for 2027 in Telangana.
why: Demonstrates regional integration of remote sensing and spatial data policies in a Global South urban setting.
action: Monitor the policy's development for potential implications on regional spatial modeling access.
